Fashion Frenzy is one of the three activities part of WoW's Anniversary. Starting hourly at 15 minutes past, players will be given a theme and 2 minutes to transmog to fit the theme. Once the timer is up, players can grab a ribbon from a nearby table and throw a ribbon onto the selected player, up to five ribbons to give out. The player with the most ribbons is deemed the winner, along with 2nd, 3rd, and 4th place winners showing their transmog on stage.

Fe'tajid is a broker located at the Gilded Landing in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market on Mythic difficulty. He is a business associate of Au'manal and claims to be the best bounty hunter in Cartel Fe. Au'manal sends Maw Walkers to help Fe'tajid after making Passably-Forged Credentials for them. Fe'tajid shipped his latest acquisitions to Tazavesh, but Cartel Zo claimed they were stuck in customs as a means of extorting him. He asked the Maw Walkers to help him fool Cartel Zo and modified their disguises to help with the task.

It can also be purchased for 20,000 Bronze from Grandmaster Jakkus at the Infinite Bazaar after earning Timerunner (Legion Remix) on any class. This is a fel-infused version of the .

Felscorned Scythe of the Unmaker is an arsenal rewarded by Mythic: Antorus the Burning Throne during Legion Remix. The appearances it unlocks are visually identical, but one is a polearm and the other a staff. This is a fel-infused version of the Scythe of the Unmaker.
